services.desc: Since the Elk Country Visitor Center opened in 2010, more than 35,000 students have come through for field trips, and it’s easy to see why it keeps them coming back. The center is built for groups of all sizes, with plenty of space for both indoor and outdoor learning at every turn. The Discovery Room sits inside the Visitor Center and works great for smaller presentations and hands-on activities. It’s cozy but has enough room for things like our antler scoring program, where students can really dig in and get their hands on something.
